summary.text: Mickey Petitto is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 70, listed with Harrison County. His legislative page lists him as Assistant Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Petitto's page lists his occupation as self-employed accountant, real estate broker and real estate appraiser.
His committee assignments include Health and Human Resources, Human Services and Public Health.
